propositions: Grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) only consider origin/main snapshot and ignore prerequisite tickets, falsely flagging symbols a depends_on ticket will create as missing/unverifiable

Machine-parseable inline citations [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be honored via two-layer protocol: deterministic advisory edge-verification (both depends_on and reverse blocks relations) plus LLM coverage judgment
Layer-1 det_citation must parse citations, verify edges in both directions via PlanContext.deps and injected resolve_deps callable, and emit advisory findings without blocking
Layer-2 grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) must apply show_ticket coverage protocol to credited citations, suppressing missing-symbol findings only if coverage is affirmatively confirmed
Reverse-lookup exceptions and unverified/uncovered citations must fail closed (advisory finding stands, no exception escapes)
Behavioral eval fixture must demonstrate positive and negative cases: verified+covered citations credit the symbol, while edge-unbacked or coverage-absent citations do not
